description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkPromptBuilder component in the OpenClawKit project, specifically validating the behavior of prompt construction with various input parameters.

classes.name: TalkPromptBuilderTests
classes.description: A test case class containing unit tests for the TalkPromptBuilder class.

methods.name: testBuildIncludesTranscript
methods.description: Verifies that the prompt includes the transcript and the 'Talk Mode active.' indicator.

methods.name: testBuildIncludesInterruptionLineWhenProvided
methods.description: Checks that the prompt correctly includes an interruption line when the interruption time is provided.

methods.name: testBuildIncludesVoiceDirectiveHintByDefault
methods.description: Ensures that the voice directive hint is included in the prompt by default.

methods.name: testBuildExcludesVoiceDirectiveHintWhenDisabled
methods.description: Verifies that the voice directive hint is excluded when specified.
